citations.quote: Gesundheitliche Probleme haben wir zum Glück keine, aber die Situation ist mühsam.
Seit August stellt der Heizkessel jede Nacht ab.
Darum braucht es jetzt einen unabhängigen Heizungsexperten, der die Ursache feststellt.
Wenn die Pilatus den Kessel nicht reparieren lässt, zahle ich den Mietzins künftig auf die Hinterlegungsstelle ein.
Ich melde Ihnen folgenden Mangel: Der Heizkessel stellt jede Nacht ab, sodass die Schlafzimmer am Morgen kalt sind.
Bitte lassen Sie den Mangel umgehend beheben.

plan.because: Needed to establish the parties, property and tenancy terms.
The supplied letter identifies the heating defect and is dated 24 August 2026.
The letter does not establish whether or when the landlord received it.
Objective dated evidence of the affected location and defect is needed.
The landlord's response, proposed work and access arrangements need documenting.
Mould is unmentioned and presumed absent for the evidence plan.
Heating is an active branch; request any report documenting inspection and service findings.
The customer reports no health problems.
An independent heating expert is requested and the cause remains disputed.
Rent deposit is being considered. Request any communicated deadline; the supplied letter asks for prompt repair but specifies no deadline.
This document is optional under the process.

questions: When did the landlord receive the 24 August letter, and do you have delivery evidence?
Has a heating service or independent expert inspected the boiler, and is a report available?
Has a specific repair deadline been communicated in writing? If so, please provide it.
What response, repair proposals or access arrangements have followed, and is the heating situation currently safe?
